say.en: Breakdown destroys an ordinary diode. A Zener diode is built to live in breakdown, and that is exactly what makes it hold a voltage steady. In this lesson: Explain Zener and avalanche breakdown.
Draw the Zener characteristic and symbol.
Design a simple Zener shunt regulator.

body.en: A Zener diode is a heavily doped silicon diode designed to work in reverse breakdown. In heavily doped junctions (breakdown below about 5 V) the strong field across the thin depletion layer pulls electrons straight out of covalent bonds: Zener breakdown. In lightly doped junctions (above about 6 V) carriers gain enough energy to knock out more carriers by collision: *avalanche breakdown*. In breakdown the voltage stays nearly constant at V_Z over a wide range of current, up to I_Z(max) = P_Z/V_Z.

points.en: *Zener* effect: heavy doping, V_Z below ~5 V
In *breakdown*, V ≈ V_Z for a wide range of I

title.en: Zener diode as a voltage regulator

say.en: The Zener diode works in reverse breakdown. Past the Zener voltage the current can change a lot while the voltage hardly changes.
The regulator: a series resistor R from the supply, the Zener reverse-biased across the load.
The series current divides: part through the Zener, part through the load.
The rules: the series current is the input minus V Z, over R. The Zener current is the series current minus the load current.

title.en: Zener as a shunt voltage regulator

body.en: The *Zener* is reverse-biased in parallel with the load, and a series resistor R drops the extra voltage. The series current is $I_S = (V_{in} - V_Z)/R$, the load current $I_L = V_Z/R_L$, and the Zener takes the rest: $I_Z = I_S - I_L$. If the input rises or the load current falls, the Zener simply takes more current, and the output stays at V_Z.

points.en: Output stays at V_Z while I_Z stays within limits

narration.en: In the regulator the series current is the input minus V Z over R, and the Zener takes whatever the load does not. So the output stays at V Z.

heading.en: Zener Regulator, Special Diodes, Clippers and Clampers

tagline.en: Zener and avalanche breakdown, the Zener shunt regulator, the LED and its series resistor, photodiode and varactor, and diode clippers and clampers.

myth.en: A Zener diode regulates by being forward biased, like an ordinary diode.

truth.en: A Zener regulator uses the diode in reverse bias, in its breakdown region, where the voltage stays close to V_Z. In forward bias a Zener behaves like an ordinary diode and gives only about 0.7 V. The constant V_Z appears only in reverse breakdown, and the series resistor is what keeps that breakdown current safe.

say.en: The Zener is connected across the load, in reverse bias, with a series resistor $R_S$ from the unregulated supply. The current in $R_S$ is shared: $I_S = I_Z + I_L$.

A clipper removes part of a waveform above or below a chosen level. In a shunt positive clipper (diode across the output, anode to the output line), the diode conducts whenever the input goes above about +0.7 V, so the positive peaks are cut off at 0.7 V.

problem.en: A 5.1 V Zener is fed from 12 V through R = 220 Ω and supplies a 1 kΩ load. Find I_S, I_L, I_Z and the power in the Zener.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A 5.1 V Zener is fed from 12 V through R = 220 Ω and supplies a 1 kΩ load. Find I_S, I_L, I_Z and the power in the Zener.

say.en: Let us solve this together. A 5.1 volts Zener is fed from 12 volts through R equals 220 ohms and supplies a 1 k ohms load. Find I S, I L, I Z and the power in the Zener.
I S equals 12 minus 5.1/220 equals 6.9 over 220 is approximately 31.4 milliamperes.
I L equals V Z over R L equals 5.1 over 1000 equals 5.1 milliamperes.
I Z equals I S - I L is approximately 31.4 minus 5.1 equals 26.3 milliamperes.
P Z equals V Z I Z equals 5.1 times 26.3 milliamperes is approximately 134 mW.
So the answer is I S is approximately 31.4 milliamperes, I L equals 5.1 milliamperes, I Z is approximately 26.3 milliamperes, P Z is approximately 134 mW.

body.en: Below about 5 V: Zener effect (heavy doping, field pulls electrons out; V_Z falls slightly as temperature rises). Above about 6 V: avalanche (collisions; V_Z rises with temperature). Around 5–6 V the two balance, giving the best temperature stability.

narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಜೀನರ್ ಡಯೋಡ್ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಡೋಪ್ ಆಗಿದ್ದು ಹಿಮ್ಮುಖ ಸ್ಥಗಿತದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಸುಮಾರು 5 V ಗಿಂತ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಜೀನರ್ ಸ್ಥಗಿತ; 6 V ಗಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಅವಲಾಂಚ್ ಸ್ಥಗಿತ. ನಿಯಂತ್ರಕ: I_S = (V_in − V_Z)/R ಮತ್ತು I_Z = I_S − I_L. I_Z ಮಿತಿಯೊಳಗಿರುವವರೆಗೆ ಔಟ್‌ಪುಟ್ V_Z ನಲ್ಲೇ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: Let us recall the key ideas. A Zener diode is heavily doped and works in reverse breakdown.
say.kn: ಮುಖ್ಯ ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ನೆನಪಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋಣ. ಜೀನರ್ ಡಯೋಡ್ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಡೋಪ್ ಆಗಿದ್ದು ಹಿಮ್ಮುಖ ಸ್ಥಗಿತದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: Zener breakdown below about 5 volts; avalanche above about 6 volts.
say.kn: ಸುಮಾರು 5 volts ಗಿಂತ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಜೀನರ್ ಸ್ಥಗಿತ; 6 volts ಗಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಅವಲಾಂಚ್ ಸ್ಥಗಿತ.

say.en: Regulator: I S equals (V in - V Z)/R and I Z equals I S - I L.
say.kn: ನಿಯಂತ್ರಕ: I S equals (V in - V Z)/R ಮತ್ತು I Z equals I S - I L.

say.en: Output stays at V Z as long as I Z stays within limits.
say.kn: I Z ಮಿತಿಯೊಳಗಿರುವವರೆಗೆ ಔಟ್‌ಪುಟ್ V Z ನಲ್ಲೇ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: Next: Optoelectronic diodes: LED and photodiode.
say.kn: ಮುಂದೆ: ದೃಗ್-ಎಲೆಕ್ಟ್ರಾನಿಕ್ ಡಯೋಡ್‌ಗಳು: LED ಮತ್ತು ಫೋಟೋಡಯೋಡ್.
